patterns.name: aligned metric table
patterns.primary: items as columns, attributes as rows; differences optional; detail on demand
patterns.avoid: huge tables with unmatched periods or metadata

patterns.name: multi-entity overlay timeline
patterns.primary: shared time x-axis and units; selected series linked to legend
patterns.avoid: single visible line for three selected entities without explanation

patterns.name: summary then evidence
patterns.primary: credible differences summary followed by common metric table and targeted chart
patterns.avoid: winner headline without data/criteria, giant empty explanation card

patterns.name: base-vs-compare differences
patterns.primary: clear A/B identities and changed fields/lines
patterns.avoid: using code diff structure for unrelated GitHub repository trend
